physical_properties.evidence: scalar drag and damping defaults are numerical regularizers; body-axis drag coefficients and rotor polar inertia are unmeasured and remain unknown

estimate_method.mass: 0.6 kg engineering baseline retained as the nominal assembled mass; current CAD exports do not encode verified material assignments or electronics masses, so this is a BOM-level estimate rather than a mesh-density measurement.
estimate_method.cg: CAD geometric origin estimate; battery/electronics placement uncertainty is covered by training randomization.
estimate_method.inertia: component-layout approximation: four generic 53 g A2212 motors at CAD rotor stations, central frame/electronics/battery mass lump, plus small central component inertias. Not a CAD-solid integration or measured inertia tensor.

aerodynamic_estimate.method: CAD-envelope projected-area estimate from body, four arms and four vertical propeller guards
aerodynamic_estimate.note: Screening estimate only; no CFD or wind-tunnel validation. Propwash/guard interference not resolved.

mass_properties_estimate.method: component-lumped estimate constrained to nominal 0.6 kg takeoff mass
mass_properties_estimate.note: Full tensor format, but not integrated from STEP solids: CAD material densities and verified battery/electronics BOM are unavailable. Products of inertia set to zero under nominal symmetry assumption.

motor_propeller.propeller_geometry_source: 3D repository kilo branch at 38d4820fc5f7e2208e6ce502ca6b54a83989196a; cad/parametric/model.params.json and output/smooth2-parametric/assembly-manifest.json. Four-blade parametric propeller; geometry is not a measured thrust/torque curve.
motor_propeller.thrust_curve_source: CAD blade-element/momentum screening calculation using cad/parametric/model.params.json prop_blade_stations, 4 blades, 158.999 mm diameter, 98.004 mm nominal pitch represented by the exported station twist, rho=1.225 kg/m3, Prandtl tip loss, generic A2212 motor model (1000KV, 0.12 ohm, 0.5A no-load), 3S 11.1V. Not a bench measurement.
motor_propeller.torque_curve_source: CAD blade-element/momentum screening calculation using cad/parametric/model.params.json prop_blade_stations, 4 blades, 158.999 mm diameter, 98.004 mm nominal pitch represented by the exported station twist, rho=1.225 kg/m3, Prandtl tip loss, generic A2212 motor model (1000KV, 0.12 ohm, 0.5A no-load), 3S 11.1V. Not a bench measurement.
motor_propeller.evidence: Catalog identity and limits partially characterized from multiple vendor sources; exact manufacturer/lot and exact motor+ESC+battery+propeller bench calibration remain unknown.
motor_propeller.catalog_data_note: Sourced values from multiple A2212/13T vendors; exact user's motor identity is not verified. Conflicting values are preserved with source attribution in vehicle_models/components/a2212_1000kv_motor.json. Catalog values do not replace bench measurements.
motor_propeller.simulator_thrust_model_policy: Runtime CAD-station blade-element/momentum model is enabled for Smooth2 only, including per-rotor axial inflow and reaction torque. It remains a screening estimate, not bench-calibrated.

bemt_estimate.warning: BEMT screening estimate includes the CAD airfoil camber zero-lift correction (-4.1545 deg), but remains sensitive to airfoil polar approximation, Reynolds number, blade flexibility, inflow, guard interference and motor vendor variation. Do not use as a verified real-flight limit.

propeller_runtime_model.method: blade-element/momentum annulus solve with Prandtl tip loss
propeller_runtime_model.inputs: CAD radial station radius fraction, chord, twist, four blades, 158.999 mm diameter, 10 mm hub radius
propeller_runtime_model.inflow: local body-axis air velocity plus angular-rate contribution at each rotor station
propeller_runtime_model.calibration: BEMT-derived screening estimate; not a measured thrust stand curve

synthetic_software_test_values.warning: Only enabled by an explicit software-only flag. Never use for physical predictions or real flight.

required_before_physical_calibration: replace nominal mass/CG/inertia priors with mesh integration using verified material densities and a verified electronics/battery bill of materials
identify exact motor, ESC, battery and propeller production parts
bench-test thrust, torque, RPM, voltage, current and temperature across throttle
measure motor step response to replace the 0.045 s lag estimate
verify actual propeller rotation and motor numbering

motor_reference.note: Catalog no-load current is available for a generic A2212 vendor reference, but exact motor identity is not verified; it is intentionally not injected into the simulation.

electrical_model.simulation_policy: Estimate shaft-power-derived current/energy telemetry only. Do not apply battery voltage sag or current limiting until exact pack resistance and ESC limits are measured.
